name: NuCal
summary: NuCal operated at the U-70 accelerator, Protvino, in the Serpukhov region. The record connects its historical apparatus to modern reinterpretations; historical results are not labeled as current operation.
detection_principle: Protons strike an iron target; weakly coupled particles traverse shielding and produce electromagnetic final states in the downstream decay region. Historical search results constrain light mediators and dark-sector models.

results.summary: Combined with data including CHARM, constrains surviving dark-photon and inelastic-dark-matter regions.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered. This record includes reinterpretations of historical data in new models. A reinterpretation paper's publication year is not the apparatus operating year, and the original experiment may primarily have targeted neutrinos, axions or other light particles.
